prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Split layout sync status sign in redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen using a split layout to emphasize account cloud sync and pet save status. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in, and sign-in redesigns have a high win rate in past tests.)
1: [home, new_flow] Desktop rendering status preview wait sub-flow: Add an interactive rendering status progress sub-flow during the waiting screen to give live visual progress on custom pet generation. (why: Home wait step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, while home new_flow changes have performed well in previous tests.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Custom pet quality check preview screen: Insert a dedicated photo preview alignment screen immediately following photo upload so users can confirm custom pet rendering quality. (why: Support logs show multiple complaints about custom pet creation failing or producing incorrect visual results.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo lighting guidance hint in photo upload: Add an explicit hint banner on the photo upload screen explaining optimal background lighting and face positioning. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or visual glitches during pet adoption.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Cloud save account protection copy update: Update sign-in copy to explicitly highlight cloud backup for pet data and recovery assurance. (why: Pets missing or reset after re-login is the single largest support issue with 8 emails last week.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet setup progress indicator wait info: Enable stage progress indicators and time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop pet resources load. (why: The home wait step has a low retention completion (89.3%) paired with a high mean time of 2336s.)
6: [finish, layout] Compact welcome checklist layout for home intro: Switch the home intro screen to a compact layout with explicit notes on desktop controls. (why: Finish stage has the lowest overall completion (64.8%), and users report confusion on controlling and hiding the pet after setup.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Direct path clarity copy update: Update choose path headline and body text to clearly contrast preset pets versus custom pet creation. (why: High average time on choose path (mean 514s) indicates user decision paralysis between paths.)

scores.note: Sign-in redesigns have a 50% win rate and strong support ticket alignment regarding post-login pet recovery.
Home new flow changes perform reasonably well, but require building a new interactive sub-flow for a minor funnel drop-off.
Adoption stage loses over 30% of users and has explicit support complaints, making a new preview screen high-impact despite client release costs.
High-loss adoption step supported by user tickets; low cost config/UI hint change with promising early data.
Config-only copy change directly addressing top support complaint, but sign_in copy changes historically show negative lift.
Easy config change for long wait times, but past home wait_info tests showed no clear effect.
Targets the highest drop-off stage (35.2% loss) with support backing, but past finish layout changes yielded negative results.
Low cost copy tweak addressing path selection latency, but past choose_path copy changes consistently underperformed.
